Picture this: You're working from home and suddenly need an important document that's saved on your office computer. With a meeting about to start, you don't have time to ask someone to send it. Situations like this are common when files are spread across multiple devices.

With a reliable remote desktop access solution like RemotePC™, accessing your files from a remote computer becomes simple and secure. You can connect to your office or home system anytime and quickly transfer the files you need without interrupting your workflow.

RemotePC™ allows seamless file and folder transfers between your local and remote computers, including mapped drives. As long as you have an active internet connection and the RemotePC™ application installed on the computer being accessed, you can move files securely between devices in seconds.

Key Remote Desktop Access Features

  • Military-Grade Security - RemotePC™ secures all remote access sessions and file transfers using TLS v1.2 / AES-256 encryption, ensuring your data stays protected during every connection.
  • Instant Remote Access - Quickly collaborate with colleagues by sharing a unique one-time Access ID and Key, allowing them to connect to your remote computer securely when needed.
  • Platform Independence - Access your remote desktop from almost anywhere. RemotePC™ supports Mac, Windows, and Linux computers, and lets you connect from devices running macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, or Android.

Additional Remote Desktop Features

  • Web Access - Use RemotePC™ Viewer Lite to access your configured remote Macs and PCs directly through a browser, anytime and from anywhere.
  • Multiple Screen Viewing - Easily switch between multiple monitors on your remote computer using the Switch Monitor option, or view all screens simultaneously.
  • Session Recording - Record your remote desktop sessions and save the recordings on your local PC or Mac for later review.
  • Remote Printing - Print files stored on your remote computer directly to your local printer without transferring the files first.
  • Whiteboard - Collaborate visually by drawing or highlighting directly on the remote screen during live sessions.
  • Chat and Sticky Notes - Communicate securely with users on the remote end using the Chat feature or leave reminders with Sticky Notes on the remote screen.
  • Lock - Protect privacy by locking the host computer's screen during a session or automatically locking it once the remote access session ends.

Administrators of Enterprise accounts can also enable or disable the file transfer feature for all users connected to their account, providing additional control over remote desktop usage.

Sign up for RemotePC™ today to simplify remote work, securely access your remote computer, and keep your files within reach wherever you are.
